svg.aria-label: A small overnight newspaper plant, seen from above and to the side, read left to right: a wire desk where story sheets print out onto a spike; a typesetting machine that composes one sheet at a time, line by line; a flat-bed press that runs on a timer; an inclined belt up to a proof desk under a lamp, with a return chute back to the typesetter for a rejected proof; and a loading dock where approved papers are tied into bundles. A wall clock shows the time and the light goes from dusk to morning.
